questions.prompt: What is the eligibility requirement to apply for Student Governor?
options: Any current student, in any year
Students planning to study at ESCG for at least one more year
Only students with a UCAS offer
questions.explanation: You must be planning to study at ESCG for at least one more year.

questions.prompt: Which are stages of the Governor application process, in order? Select all that apply.
options: Submit online nomination form by midday, Fri 16 October
Informal conversation about your interest (2-5 November)
Student ballot if more candidates than places (9-23 November)
Committee recommendation 24 November; Board appointment 14 December
questions.explanation: All four are the stages of the Governor application process.

questions.prompt: Which phrase from the deck captures the Encourage Unity message?
options: 'One person's complaint is an opinion. A group saying the same thing is evidence.'
questions.explanation: One person's complaint is an opinion. A group saying the same thing is evidence - and evidence is what changes decisions.
